subject: general
question:
Consider the following pairs:

 
 

 
 
**Conservation Instrument**

 
 
 
**Status of Leatherback Sea Turtle**

 
 
 

 
 
I.IUCN Red List

 
 
 
Endangered

 
 
 

 
 
II.CITES

 
 
 
Appendix I

 
 
 

 
 
III.Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972

 
 
 
Schedule I

 
 
 

How many pairs given above are correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Environmental concerns regarding the impact of developmental activities in Great Nicobar Island have highlighted the conservation status of protected marine species such as the Leatherback Sea Turtle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Leatherback Sea Turtle is classified as Endangered under the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Red List. **Hence, Pair I is correctly matched. **
 
• The species is included in Appendix I of the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES), which provides the highest level of protection against international commercial trade. **Hence, Pair II is correctly matched. **
 
• In India, the Leatherback Sea Turtle is protected under Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, granting it the highest degree of legal protection. **Hence, Pair III is correctly matched. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Leatherback Sea Turtle is the largest living sea turtle species in the world.
 
• It is known for its leathery shell unlike the hard shells of other sea turtles.
 
• Great Nicobar Island is one of the important nesting habitats of Leatherback Sea Turtles in India.
 
• Major threats to the species include coastal development, marine pollution, accidental fishing net entanglement, and climate change.
